x: Peter Gardener had a good race in the Wilsons School cross country championship. Staying back in the field while the early leaders ran themselves out, he then worked his way through and eventually won by some 500 metres.
Peter Gardener reinforced his claim to be Belgrave's top Youth runner over the country by winning from Richard Danpure. Danny Richards kept going well for third place.
His effort was successful and he too managed to reach home one second ahead of his rival Peter Gardener, only a Youth and whose plucky efforts fully deserved a medal.
